transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what’s been bringing you in today?

Um... yeah. I guess I just... I haven't been doing so great lately. Ever since I moved into this new room, it's pretty busted up. I'm up all night trying to fix leaks, or messing with the heat. Then I'm dragging at work, showing up late, messing up jobs I usually do fine. And I guess... I've been snapping at people a lot. So, yeah. That's why I'm here.
Have you been feeling down, depressed, or have you lost interest in things you usually enjoy?
I don't... I wouldn't say depressed. Just... tired, mostly. And I haven't really had time for much else anyway, so... I don't know. Not really.
Have you noticed that things you usually enjoy don’t seem to interest you anymore?
I mean... like I just said, I haven't really had the time to do much anyway. It's not that I don't care about things anymore, I just... I'm too beat to do anything when I get off work. So, no.
You mentioned snapping at people a lot lately—has that been happening more than usual, or is it something that’s always happened?

It's... definitely more than usual. I'm usually pretty easygoing on the site. But lately, I just... I don't have the patience. Someone messes up, or even just asks me a question when I'm trying to focus, and I just bite their head off. It's not like me.
Have you been feeling guilty about snapping at people, or like you're not handling things as well as you should?
I don't know. Not really guilty, I guess. It just... it happens, and then we move on. I'm just trying to get through the shifts, honestly. I haven't really thought about it like that.
Have you noticed yourself losing interest in things that you used to enjoy, even when you do have time to do them?
I don't know. Like I said, I don't really get much free time. When I do get a day off, I just sleep mostly. I'm not really trying to do much else. So... no, I guess not.
How often would you say you feel angry or irritable throughout the day, and does it last for most of the day?
I don't really keep track. It's just... when things happen. I wouldn't say it's all day, just when someone gets in my way or messes something up. Then it passes.
Even when you do have some free time, like on your days off, do you find that you don’t enjoy things that you used to like doing?
I mean... I think I just said, I mostly just sleep. It's not like I'm trying to go do stuff and not liking it. I'm just beat from work, so... I don't really do anything to enjoy anyway.
When you’re not at work and there’s nothing pressing going on, do you still find yourself feeling irritable or on edge, or does it mostly only happen when things are going wrong?
Nah, not really. If I'm just at home and nothing's going on... I'm just sleeping or whatever. It's really only when stuff gets messed up, like I said. I don't just sit around mad for no reason.
Even when things are going okay, do you find yourself feeling down or hopeless for most of the day, more days than not?
No... not really. I don't really get like that. If things are fine, then... they're fine. I don't sit around feeling hopeless or whatever.
Do you ever feel overwhelmed or like you can't cope with the things you have to do on a daily basis?
I don't know about overwhelmed. I mean, I do what I gotta do. It's just work. I get it done. It's just frustrating when things get screwed up, that's all.
Even when you're not tired and have some free time, do you find that you don't take pleasure in things you used to enjoy?
Nah, not really. If I got some free time... I still do whatever I normally do. It's fine.
Over the past two weeks, have you felt down or lost interest in things for most of the day, more days than not?
No... I mean, I think I just said that. I don't get all down like that. Just been going to work and doing my normal stuff.
Even when you're not tired or busy, do you find that you no longer enjoy activities that you used to like doing?
I mean... didn't you just ask me that? Like I said, no. If I have time, I do what I usually do. It's the same as always.
Have you found yourself getting more easily upset or frustrated by small things lately, even things that wouldn’t have bothered you much before?

I guess. I mean... yeah, maybe snapping at people a little. But ever since I moved into this busted-up room, it's just... I'm always up half the night fixing leaks or messing with the heat. So I'm dragging myself in late to work, messing up stuff I normally handle fine. It just gets to you, I guess.
Has the stress from your living situation been affecting your ability to function at work or in your daily life overall?

Yeah, I guess. My foreman pulled me aside... said I could lose my shot at moving up to crew lead if I keep slipping. I've been messing up some paperwork and scheduling stuff, too. Just hard to focus when I'm so tired.
Even when you're not dealing with the problems at home or work, do you find that you don't get pleasure out of things that used to make you happy?
I... look, didn't we just go over this? No. When I actually get a minute to myself, I still like doing my normal stuff. It's not like that.
Have you noticed that activities you used to enjoy feel less satisfying or take more effort to get into, even when you’re not tired or busy?
I just said no. It's not like that. If I get the time, I still like doing things. I just don't have the time or energy right now.
Even when things are going smoothly and you're not tired, do you find that activities you used to enjoy feel less satisfying or don't interest you as much as they used to?
Look, man... I don't know how many different ways you want me to say it. No. When I'm not wiped out, I still like my stuff. It's just the same answer.
